rule: Metadata only. The hub never hosts, mirrors or re-publishes participant data. Every file comes from the original source.

datasets.title: Brain-to-Text '25, participant T15 copy task (Card et al. 2024)

citation.text: Card et al., NEJM 391 (2024). Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.dncjsxm85

licence.attribution: Data: Card et al. 2024 (Dryad, CC0). No attribution is required; please cite the paper.

personal_data.note: Neural recordings of one participant. Fidetype commits only salted hashes and aggregate numbers.

forms.description: Per-trial RNN phoneme logits and sentences (t15_copyTask.pkl).
Neural features, partitions train / val / test (t15_copyTask_neuralData.zip). Holds the same trials as the pkl form.

same_units.note: About 45 % of the b2t25-t15 test trials are in the HDF5 train partition (T15 split audit). A training-data declaration and an overlap check are required (P6-10).

download.instructions: Download from Dryad (login needed) or a mirror with the same SHA-256. Load the pkl only with fidetype.adapters.b2t25.load_copytask (safe unpickler, digest check).

citation.text: Levy et al., Nature Neuroscience 29 (2026). Dataset bcbl190626/SpanishBCBL (Hugging Face)

licence.attribution: Contains data from the SpanishBCBL dataset (BCBL; Levy et al. 2026), licensed CC BY-NC 4.0. Non-commercial research use only.

personal_data.note: MEG recordings and typed text of volunteers. Results and weights derived from it are research-only.

forms.description: 316 MEG files (MEG/FIF/**/*.fif) and logs (MEG/logs/*.mat), 251.36 GB. No single archive.

files.name: MEG/FIF/**/*.fif + MEG/logs/*.mat
files.note: verify per-file sizes against the Hugging Face file list; a per-file manifest is gap 79 (P13-07)

forms.description: Local preprocessing cache (S*/*.json + .npz sidecars) built by tools/data/preprocess_spanishbcbl.py. Never committed.

adapters.emits: frames (character CTC log-probabilities of a decoder)

datasets.title: Toronto forearm sEMG typing gestures (Achituve et al. 2025)

citation.text: Achituve, Beutel, Eby, Fetaya, Koivisto, Zariffa, Sci Data 12:440 (2025). Borealis doi:10.5683/SP3/KV65VI

licence.attribution: Contains data from Achituve et al. 2025 (University of Toronto, Borealis doi:10.5683/SP3/KV65VI), licensed CC BY 4.0. Fidetype changed nothing in the data; splits are ours.

forms.description: EMG typing dataset.zip (Intan .rhd recordings, key logs).

download.instructions: Download https://borealisdata.ca/api/access/datafile/836662 and extract only the data files (.rhd, .txt, .csv).

datasets.prepare: python experiments/2026-11-11-emg-toronto/prep.py (window cache; a hub command is gap 78, P13-06)

adapters.emits: key-press frames (vocab_type key) and their CTC character form
